newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Woolworth Cyprus plans 3 mln pound bonds.
newsitem.headline: Woolworth Cyprus plans 3 mln pound bonds.

text.p: Woolworth Cyprus plans a three million pounds ($6.5 million) five-year variable-rate bond issue priced at par, stockbrokers Sigma Severis and Athienitis said on Wednesday.

The issue, due in January, will pay eight percent for the first 2.5 years with a floating rate thereafter, but always one percent above the highest interest rate offered on government bonds and with a minimum of 5.5 percent, a release from the stockbrokers said.
The minimum annual return for the first 2.5 years is 8.16 percent.
The issue will be listed on the Cyprus Stock Exchange and the minimum investment is 1000 pounds.
Woolworth is offering a 'bunny bond' option, allowing investors to reinvest coupons in additional bonds with the same conditions.
Investors can trade the bonds on the stock exchange, or -- after 2.5 years and after giving six months' notice -- can redeem them at par.
Investors will have priority in buying any further bonds the company may issue.
